cust_acme_ops: Hey team — our nightly indexing backfill started failing around 02:10 UTC. Indexer logs show a mix of dim mismatch rejects and 504s. Customer is seeing ~40% of batches fail, partial inserts cause duplicate billing entries. Can we triage?
support_jess: sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the indexer error snippet and an example payload? also which embedding model/version are you using? :eyes:
cust_acme_ops: using model: open-embed-large-2026-07 (we pinned yesterday). payload sample below, anonymized. errors: 
```
ERROR Indexer: insert failed batch_id=bf-2026-03-17-02 model=open-embed-large-2026-07 reason=dim_mismatch expected=768 got=1536
ERROR Indexer: write timeout batch_id=bf-2026-03-17-02 reason=upstream_504 elapsed_ms=12050
WARN Billing: duplicate_charge detected request_id=xyz-123 attempts=2
```
payload sample: 
```json
{"id": "doc-101", "embedding": [0.001, 0.002, ... /* 1536 floats */], "meta": {"source":"s3://acme/delta/2026/03/16"}}
```
support_jess: thanks. couple quick notes: 1) the expected dim for the vector table is 768 (we saw that in your schema), 2) model open-embed-large-2026-07 should produce 768, not 1536 — is there a model variant mixup? 3) billing dup likely due to retrying non-idempotent requests while some partial writes succeeded.
eng_ml_ryan: quick thought — some of our newer quantized variants return doubled-length arrays when callers accidentally request `return_hidden_states=true` on the client side (we emit concatenated layers). Could the client SDK set that flag?
cust_acme_ops: we didn't change flags, but our ingestion job spins up many workers; config might differ between canaries and bulk. will grep.
eng_sre_maya: I'm seeing increased tail latency in the embedding endpoint around 02:05 UTC that lines up with your spikes. Autoscaler spun up new pods then and cold starts bumped median latency from 80ms to ~500ms for the XO-series nodes — could cause timeouts in your indexer which has a 10s batch timeout. Suggest increasing indexer timeout to 30s temporarily and reduce batch size to 50.
indexer_bot: indexer-config dump: 
```
{
  "batch_size": 200,
  "batch_timeout_ms": 10000,
  "retry_policy": {"max_attempts": 2, "idempotency_key": null}
}
```
oncall_dale: +1 to reducing batch size and raising timeout. Also add idempotency_key header computed per-record-set to avoid billing duplicates. Billing bot: note that duplicate charges happen when server processed the request but client retried without idempotency; we can reverse duplicates but need request_ids to match.
billing_bot: action_required: submit ticket with `request_id` list and timestamps. Use `billing-reviews@redwood` if urgent.
support_jess: can you run a quick check to confirm whether the embedding vectors are 1536 at generation time? sample python snippet: 
```python
# quick check
vec = model.embed(texts)
print(len(vec[0]))
```
If it's 1536, then we need to determine whether the client is calling an alternate endpoint or toggling a param.
cust_acme_ops: ran check — found that the canary job uses `open-embed-large-2026-07:v2` while bulk job uses `open-embed-large-2026-07:v2-quant` (hidden flag set by infra image). bulk returns 1536. we have mismatch.
eng_ml_ryan: confirmed: quant variant currently concatenates two halves for legacy compatibility; it should have been a 768 output but we used a deprecated conversion. Fix options: 1) update quant variant to return 768 (hotfix), 2) enforce server-side dim check and reject earlier (mitigation), 3) orchestrate backfill to re-embed with consistent model.
pm_ana: customer impact: partial index writes causing duplicate charges + search quality regressions. Recommend immediate mitigation then a scheduled backfill during low-traffic window.
support_jess: mitigation plan for now: 
- Immediately flip bulk ingestion workers to canonical `open-embed-large-2026-07:v2` (not quant) — fastest rollback.
- Patch indexer config: set `batch_size`=50, `batch_timeout_ms`=30000, and `retry_policy.idempotency_key`=enabled.
- Add a pre-ingest validation lambda to reject vectors where `len(vec) != 768` with a clear error (so we fail fast, avoid partial writes).
eng_sre_maya: also throttle concurrent workers during autoscaler cold-start: set `MAX_CONCURRENCY=8` for the job runner to reduce P95.
oncall_dale: I'm taking the rollback to canonical model now and will monitor. will report back with logs. :eyes:
indexer_bot: job rollback started at 02:34 UTC, job_id=rb-8891
cust_acme_ops: rollback applied, re-ran 1000 docs -> 0 dim_mismatch, 3 transient 504s retried successfully, no duplicates observed so far. :thumbsup:
support_jess: great. next: backfill plan — we need to re-embed objects created between 2026-03-16T00:00 and 2026-03-17T03:00 using the canonical model. propose canary 10k docs, then bulk 2M docs over 6 hours during maintenance window. Add idempotency keys for each doc to avoid duplicates.
eng_ml_ryan: I'll push a small server-side validation that trims concatenated vectors when the quant variant is called by mistake (defensive), and we'll schedule a proper model-variant update to remove the concatenation behavior in the quant image.
billing_bot: prepared reversal checklist and will standby for the request_id list if duplicates are found.
support_jess: repro steps for support/escalation page: 
1) reproduce locally with quant image: `docker run image:open-embed-large-2026-07-quant` then `python samples/repro_embed.py` to see 1536 dims.
2) run indexer with small batch and idempotency header to ensure no duplicate writes:
```bash
curl -X POST https://indexer.internal/ingest -H "Idempotency-Key: $DOC_ID" -d @batch.json
```
3) check indexer logs: `kubectl logs deploy/indexer -c ingest | grep batch_id`

support_jess: I'm adding this thread to the support playbook and will send the rollback + backfill schedule to the customer. any objections?
pm_ana: no objections. make sure communications include expected customer credits if any duplicate charges are found.
oncall_dale: monitoring: CPU and p95 latency returning to normal after rollback. keeping watch for any billing anomalies. will update again in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
cust_acme_ops: thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turnaround. will confirm post-backfill search quality.
support_jess: closing loop: followup items assigned: 
- eng_ml_ryan: model variant fix and defensive trim (ETA 48h)
- eng_sre_maya: autoscaler cold-start mitigation & job concurrency defaults (ETA 24h)
- billing_bot: standby for reversal ops (as needed)
- support_jess: customer comms + backfill schedule (ETA 4h)
thanks all! :party:
